facts.statement: The genus Arduodens was described based on isolated cladodont teeth discovered in central Iran.
facts.quote: It was described from isolated cladodont teeth found in deposits from the upper Frasnian to lower Fammenian of central Iran.

facts.statement: The name Arduodens comes from the Latin words for 'steep' and 'tooth'.
facts.quote: Its name is derived from the Latin Arduus meaning steep and dens meaning tooth.

facts.statement: Arduodens belongs to the parent group Elasmobranchii.
Arduodens is classified in the class Chondrichthyes.
The genus Arduodens is currently known from only one species, A. flammeus.
facts.quote: It is currently known from a singular species, A. flammeus.
